responsibility: Defines the central `Interner` trait and associated abstractions that parameterize all of `rustc_type_ir` over a concrete compiler representation. It specifies every interned type-system component, the constructors and queries needed to build and inspect them, trait-solver cache integration, generic-argument and canonical-variable creation, and utility adapters such as the small-collection `CollectAndApply` helper and the bridge from an interner to the solver search graph context.
